record.paper_title: Solutions to Some Open Problems About Four Sombor-Index-Like Graph Invariants
record.original_question: For a finite graph G, let E(G) be the edge set of G and let d_u be the degree of a vertex u of G. Define the Sombor-index-like graph invariant SO4 by SO4(G) = (π/2) times the sum over all edges uv in E(G) of ((d_u^2 + d_v^2)/(d_u + d_v))^2. For a fixed order n, let T_n be the class of all trees with n vertices. What is the maximum possible value of SO4 on T_n?

evidence.quote: Problem 2. Find the maximum value of the graph invariants SO4 in the class Tn.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a finite simple graph G with edge set E(G), let d_u denote the degree of a vertex u in G. Define the graph invariant
  SO4(G) = (π/2) · Σ_{uv ∈ E(G)} ((d_u^2 + d_v^2)/(d_u + d_v))^2.
Let T_n denote the class of all trees on n vertices (n ≥ 2). Determine the maximum value of SO4(G) as G ranges over T_n, and characterize all trees in T_n attaining this maximum.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of determining the maximum of the Sombor-index-like invariant SO4 over the class of trees with n vertices is reported as completely solved in the work addressing the original open problems, where it is stated that the corresponding problem in the tree class is solved completely.

status_evidence.title: Solutions to Some Open Problems About Four Sombor-Index-Like Graph Invariants
status_evidence.claim: The maximum of SO4 over trees with n vertices has been determined.
